相关性: 该论文展示了约束贝叶斯优化在工业过程优化中的应用，其方法可迁移到植入物设计中的多约束优化问题。
边界: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for biomedical implants, lacks biomechanical context, and does not consider implant-specific constraints such as stress shielding or micromotion.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· The paper aims to develop a real-time load-sharing optimization framework for compressor stations that improves energy efficiency while ensuring safe operation against surge constraints.
Method· A constrained Bayesian optimization approach is employed, using Gaussian process surrogate models to learn the economic objective and surge-related constraints directly from plant response data, with safety incorporated via measured distance-to-surge.
Result· The proposed framework achieved energy savings up to 2.6% in parallel and 3.1% in series configurations, while maintaining positive surge margins and avoiding anti-surge activation.
Validation· The method was validated in a high-fidelity dynamic simulation environment for both parallel and series compressor stations, initialized with only three operating points.

Motivation· To investigate the effect of spatial laser beam shaping on surface roughness in laser powder bed fusion, aiming to improve as-built surface quality.

动机· 提高LPBF制造多孔结构的分辨率，缩小设计与实际性能差距。
方法· 采用25微米激光束和2-15微米粉末的微LPBF制造316L多孔芯。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To overcome the resolution limitations of conventional LPBF in fabricating porous media, thereby reducing the gap between designed and manufactured structures.

方法· 建立含初始几何缺陷的有限元模型，结合Kriging代理模型与NSGA-II算法对沟槽参数进行多目标优化。

Motivation· To address the recycling challenges of thermosetting epoxy resins, this study develops recyclable PMMA-based thermoplastic sandwich panels and investigates their in-plane compressive buckling behavior.
Method· A finite element model with initial geometric imperfections is established and validated, then a Kriging surrogate model coupled with the NSGA-II algorithm is used for multi-objective optimization of groove parameters.
Result· The optimized configuration reduces structural mass by 2.24% while increasing critical buckling load and shear modulus by 5.71% and 10.27%, respectively.
Validation· The finite element model is validated through compression and buckling tests, and the optimization results are verified by finite element analysis.

Motivation· To efficiently optimize designs under the accuracy-cost trade-off inherent in CFD simulations with varying mesh resolutions.

Motivation· This study aims to understand how lattice architecture, nominal feature size, and heat treatment jointly influence the tensile behavior of L-PBF Inconel 718 lattices for lightweight load-bearing applications.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Standard PINNs ignore the inherent angular separability of the Laplacian on spherical domains, leading to inefficient training and less interpretable solutions.
Method· A hybrid PINN is proposed where a compact network learns only radial expansion coefficients while angular dependence is provided analytically via associated Legendre polynomials, reducing the PDE residual to a one-dimensional radial ODE per mode.
Result· The hybrid model achieves comparable accuracy (relative error below 4%) with roughly half the training time and better performance at low capacity, while the standard PINN is slightly more accurate at larger capacity.
Validation· The method is validated on a spherical-shell Laplace benchmark with a known closed-form multipole solution, comparing RMSE, MAE, and relative error against a matched-budget standard PINN.

Motivation· To improve the serving efficiency and compatibility of physics-informed neural networks in production environments.
Method· Introduces derivative-graph baking, which symbolically differentiates a tanh MLP offline and emits a forward-only program for derivative queries.
Result· Enables derivative-valued queries on standard inference backends and shows that output-space accuracy monitoring fails to detect physics degradation.
Validation· Validated through a benchmark comparison against a Crank-Nicolson solver and quantization tests.
